name: Petro Home Services
notes: Researched from public petro.com pages only (Pay Your Bill, My Account FAQs, Customer FAQs, SmartPay). The My Account portal lives on myenergyaccount.com/petro (shared Star Group platform); its sign-in page did not render without scripts, so auth details come from the My Account FAQs: the username is the account email, registration needs the account number (XX-XXXXXXX), a phone number and an email, and enrollment is confirmed by an emailed link. No MFA is described, so the family default is kept. AutoPay is enrolled under Payment Options > Enroll in AutoPay; the FAQ gives no cancel button, only that deleting the linked bank account unlinks AutoPay (autopay_cancel kept supported, marked inferred). SmartPay budget enrollment is by phone (800-645-4328). Late fees may apply but no amount is published, so none is modelled. No mailing address for payments and no online close-account path are published; moving is handled by calling customer service. Independent review 2026-10-09: the My Account FAQ says gift and debit cards with Visa/MasterCard/Discover/AMEX logos ARE accepted (builder had the opposite) and card payments are credited 1-2 or 2-3 business days depending on the 4 PM cutoff; help corrected. The FAQ's 'cancel my billing enrollment' answer is to call Customer Service; whether that covers AutoPay is unclear, so autopay_cancel stays inferred. Review 2026-10-09 (2): the inferred autopay_cancel note was removed from the capability because supported-capability notes render on the AutoPay page as if the biller said them; the inference is recorded here instead.

help.title: Ways to pay your Petro bill
paragraphs: My Account is the quickest way to pay. Sign in, open Payment Options and choose One Time Payment, then enter the amount and the payment date. You can pay from a checking or savings account, or with a Visa, MasterCard, American Express or Discover credit card; debit and gift cards carrying one of those logos work too. Add a card first with Add Credit Card on the View Payment Accounts page.

Bank payments submitted before 4 PM Eastern on a business day are processed that day; later ones move to the next business day. A card payment starts processing right away: one made before 4 PM Eastern on a business day is credited within one to two business days, and one made later, or on a weekend or holiday, within two to three. Schedule payments no later than the due date, since late fees may apply.
If you have no My Account login, the Make Payment link on the Pay Your Bill page opens a one-time payment page. For billing questions call Customer Service at 800-645-4328.
steps: Enter the amount and payment date.
Pick a payment account and submit.

help.title: Enroll in AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay pays your Petro bills automatically from a saved payment account. To enroll, sign in to My Account, open Payment Options and select Enroll in AutoPay.
If you delete the bank account that AutoPay uses, AutoPay is unlinked and any payments marked Scheduled from that account are cancelled. You then need to enroll again with a different account.
steps: Choose the payment account and confirm.

help.title: Scheduling and cancelling payments
paragraphs: For bank payments you can pick a future date on the Schedule Payment page. Scheduled payments appear on Payment Options with the status Scheduled.

To stop one before it runs, find it on Payment Options and press Cancel Payment. Payment Options also lists processed payments for up to 12 months, and you get a confirmation each time a payment is scheduled or processed.

help.title: Paperless invoices and statements
paragraphs: You can stop paper invoices and statements from the Accounts section of My Account. You can also choose paperless when you add an account under Online Services, Add/Remove Accounts.

help.title: Register for My Account
paragraphs: To register you need your Petro account number (it looks like XX-XXXXXXX), a phone number and an email address. Petro emails you a link to confirm enrollment, and your login works as soon as you confirm. Your username is the email address on the account; use Forgot Password if you lose your password.

help.title: SmartPay budget plan
paragraphs: SmartPay looks at your yearly heating costs and turns them into the same payment every month, so winter bills do not spike. There is no enrollment fee and you can join at any time.

Once a year Petro settles the plan: an overpayment is credited to your account and a shortfall is billed, and the monthly amount is adjusted. To enroll in SmartPay, call Customer Service at 800-645-4328.

help.title: Moving or closing your account
paragraphs: There is no online form to close a Petro account. If you are moving, call Customer Service at 800-645-4328 with the name and contact details of the person Petro should work with. Petro can also set up service at your new home and transfer a protection plan to the buyer.
